title: Find Maximum
description: Write a function that finds and returns the largest number in a list. For example, given [3, 7, 2, 9, 1] the function should return 9.
instructions: Complete the find_maximum function so it returns the largest number in the list.
hints: Think about how you would find the largest number if you were looking through the list by hand.
Try keeping track of the largest number you have seen so far as you loop through the list.
Start by assuming the first element is the maximum, then update it if you find something bigger.
